title: Insurance
description: Adapt reviews to insurers, reinsurers and insurance intermediaries, and to the software that distributes, prices or administers their products in the EU.
context: Ask the compliance owner whether the organization is an insurance undertaking or an intermediary within DORA Art. 2(1)(n) or (o), or excluded by Art. 2(3). This sector preselects the dora-financial-entity and insurance-distribution patterns; decline DORA when it is out of scope.
Record whether the product distributes insurance, prices risk or handles claims, and which product approval process (IDD Art. 25) governs the products it changes.
Life and health insurance can use health data and high-risk AI (AI Act Annex III point 5(c)): ask the privacy and legal owners before adding either to pricing or underwriting.

sources.title: European Commission, AI Act Service Desk, Annex III: high-risk AI systems referred to in Article 6(2)
